title: HtmlDfn
responsibility: Renders the native dfn element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlDfn.attributes
inputs.description: Native dfn attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlDfn.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native dfn element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlDfn
outputs.description: The actual native dfn element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
